title: The headline-accuracy trap (synthetic)
story_brief: A vendor claims their screening tool is 92% accurate. Check the validation cohort before anyone signs.

choice.label: Why is the headline figure misleading?

options.text: The threshold is set too low.
The condition is rare, so saying 'no' to everyone is usually right.
The cohort is too small to mean anything.

common_mistakes.message: That is the overall accuracy, not the sensitivity.

hints: Sensitivity only looks at people who truly have the condition.
Count the true positives and the false negatives.
debrief: Accuracy hides poor sensitivity when the condition is rare.

review_items.label: Sensitivity
review_items.explanation: True positives divided by everyone with the condition.
